## Plugin reference

- Description: App shell for the Demo sandbox: registers the /demo app entry, whose one page is the Agent Manager rendered in-process on made-up data (DemoScope + AppEmbed over the agent manager's demo scenario).
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Apps.App` "Demo" → `DemoLayout`
  - Uses:
    - `apps-core.Apps`
    - `apps-core/app-embed.AppEmbed`
    - `framework/browser-server/demo/scope.DemoScope`
    - `layouts/miller.PaneOverlayHost`
    - `primitives/bar.Bar`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
- Core:
  - Uses: `primitives/pane.defineApp`
  - Exports (values): `demoApp`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --background`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-lg`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --radius`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --spacing`
